prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: mythological creature education catalogue. Create one painterly realistic portrait 2:3, coherent rich brushwork and dramatic readable storytelling. No text or watermark. Ihizi in documented red bull form guarding Mari's cave: one enormous forceful red bull blocks a towering Basque cave entrance, horns lowered at a small traveler halted outside. Emphasize guardian confrontation rather than pastoral animal. Natural bull anatomy four legs two horns one tail, red coat, no wings, natural cliff light. Guardian blocking action is sourced; scale composition and traveler clothes editorial. No arbitrary glowing effects, colored mist, glyphs or ribbons.
Targeted edit: Edit this image only to correct the bull's size: replace the colossal red bull with one powerful natural adult Betizu bull, shoulder height about1.4 metres while adult traveler is1.8 metres. They stand at same distance in one shared ground plane so the person is clearly taller than bull's shoulders. Bull blocks narrow cave entrance with lowered head, guardian action retained. Four natural bull legs with cloven hooves, two horns one tail. Retain painterly portrait2:3 and red coat, cave, traveler, natural light. No giant scale, no glow.
depicted_variant: Natural-scale red bull guarding Mari's cave against an adult traveler.
visual_requirements: Natural scale and coherent cloven-hoof anatomy
rationale: Replace animal portrait with documented guardian/battle action without unsupported gigantism.
aura: Presence through source-supported iconography, narrative action, posture, scale and natural scene light; no generic magical glow.

visual_review.notes: Corrected native inspected: natural-scale strong red bull, traveler taller than bull shoulders, guards cave threshold, coherent cloven hooves and horns.
